management_notes: Corporate development capability is evidenced by the October 2025 Exclusivity Agreement with Avesoro Resources Inc. (Liberia's largest gold miner), which included a US$200,000 exclusivity payment — a genuine validation signal. A senior geologist was recently brought in to lead the project into its resource-estimate phase, suggesting the team is building appropriately for the next stage. However, the broader management team has limited public profile and no independently verified track record of taking a West African project from discovery to production. Score reflects an early-stage team that is geologically guided and corporately building, with key questions unanswered.
geology_notes: Strong early-stage drill results: gold intersected in 37 of 39 holes at the Arthington discovery, defining a 16km gold corridor along the Todi shear zone in Liberia's Birimian-age greenstone belt — the same geological sequence that hosts Ghana's Ashanti gold belt. Total land package is 2,316 km²; the flagship Todi Gold Project covers 418 km² and is in advanced permitting for a Mineral Development Agreement. A Q4 2026 maiden resource estimate is planned to cover the Arthington zone and the Ben Ben to Youth Camp trend. No formal resource estimate exists yet. A high-resolution drone survey (magnetics + LiDAR) is underway to assist in delineating the system. Score reflects promising hit rate and geological analogy discounted for pre-resource status and unconfirmed grades.
capital_notes: Cap-table data unavailable — no extracted filings JSON in the repository cache for ZAU. As a TSXV-stage explorer in Liberia, Zodiac Gold almost certainly carries a typical junior capital structure: multiple warrant tranches from successive exploration financings, with consequent overhang risk on the share price. The scale of the Avesoro exclusivity payment (US$200K) implies a modest market cap and treasury. Dilution from future financings required to advance to resource estimate and beyond is a structural concern. Score reflects the uncertainty and typical TSXV overhang risk rather than confirmed data.
catalyst_notes: Q4 2026 maiden resource estimate is a clear binary catalyst that could materially re-rate the stock if the 16km Arthington system delivers economically interesting grades and tonnage. The 2026 exploration program includes drill results from the ongoing campaign (37/39 hit rate builds anticipation) and results from the high-resolution drone survey, each representing a stand-alone news event. The Avesoro exclusivity agreement could convert to a joint-venture, strategic investment, or acquisition discussion — a corporate catalyst entirely independent of drilling. Mineral Development Agreement permitting is advancing in parallel. Multiple converging catalysts in the next 6–12 months give this a better catalyst score than its early stage would otherwise suggest.
acquisition_notes: No resource estimate exists, making a conventional P/NAV comparison impossible. The Avesoro exclusivity agreement (US$200K) is the clearest real-world M&A signal: Liberia's largest gold operator paid for priority access, implying strategic interest that goes beyond a speculative look. For a pre-resource company, acquisition value is a function of drill-result momentum, resource size, and jurisdiction fit — all of which are too early to quantify with confidence. Grade and tonnage potential along the 16km corridor are genuinely promising but unbooked. Score reflects pre-resource stage with one credible strategic-interest signal.
analyst_summary: Zodiac Gold is a pre-resource West African explorer with a genuinely compelling early-stage drilling record: 37 of 39 holes hit gold along a 16km corridor in the Todi shear zone of Liberia, a geologically analogous setting to the Birimian-age belts of Ghana and Burkina Faso. The October 2025 Avesoro exclusivity deal (US$200K) provides an independent validation from Liberia's largest gold miner. The Q4 2026 maiden resource estimate is the pivotal near-term catalyst. Key risks are Liberia's regulatory and infrastructure environment (relative to more established African mining jurisdictions), unknown share dilution from successive TSXV financings, and the standard pre-resource uncertainty around grade continuity at economic cut-off. A WATCH ahead of the resource release and with greater share-structure transparency needed before considering entry. Confidence is low given absent cap-table data and the frontier jurisdiction.
